يزدلفون (form VIII)
# يَزْدَلِفُونَ (yazdalifūna) /jaz.da.li.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
# يُزْدَلَفُونَ (yuzdalafūna) /juz.da.la.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
